title: Postgres Clusters / Cluster Detail
description: Per-cluster PostgreSQL metrics from postgres_exporter, overlaid with declared values from the postgresql.acid.zalan.do CR.

panels.title: Pods Up / Desired
panels.description: Pods reporting pg_up=1 versus spec.numberOfInstances in the CR.

panels.title: Uptime (primary)
panels.description: Derived from pg_postmaster_start_time_seconds. Requires the postmaster collector to be enabled on the exporter.

panels.title: Pods by Role
panels.description: One row per spilo-role, listing the pods currently holding that role. Sourced from pg_up, so it lists scrape targets rather than live pods. A role of "None" means the pod carries no spilo-role label — usually a pod Patroni has not yet assigned, or a PodMonitor that is not promoting the label.

panels.title: Pods by Role Over Time
panels.description: Primary/replica counts over time. A simultaneous dip in master and rise in replica (or vice versa) marks a Patroni failover.

panels.title: Connections vs max_connections
panels.description: Total backends against the server's configured limit.

panels.title: Transactions / sec
panels.description: Commit and rollback rate on the primary.

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: blks_hit / (blks_hit + blks_read). Sustained values below ~0.95 often indicate undersized shared_buffers.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$namespace", cluster_name="$cluster_name", spilo_role="master", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
clamp_min(
  sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="$namespace", cluster_name="$cluster_name", spilo_role="master", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval]))
  + sum(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="$namespace", cluster_name="$cluster_name", spilo_role="master", datname=~"$datname"}[$__rate_interval])),
  1
)

panels.title: Database Size vs Declared Volume
panels.description: Sum of database sizes on the primary against spec.volume.size from the CR. The dashed line is per-instance capacity.

panels.title: CPU vs CR Request / Limit
panels.description: Actual container CPU joined to the CR's declared request and limit. Uses kube_pod_labels as the bridge, since cAdvisor metrics do not pass through the PodMonitor.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (
  rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container="postgres"}[$__rate_interval])
    * on (namespace, pod) group_left(cluster_name)
    label_replace(kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_application="spilo", label_cluster_name="$cluster_name"}, "cluster_name", "$1", "label_cluster_name", "(.*)")
)

panels.title: Replication Lag
panels.description: Replica lag in seconds. Metric name varies by exporter version — adjust to pg_replication_lag if pg_replication_lag_seconds is absent.
